biggest_catch: AppNana is a real, live app — but the company publishes no points-to-dollar conversion rate and no minimum redemption threshold in any official source. 'Nanas convert to gift cards' is the entire public payout statement, so the catalog's 'cash out from 30,000 nanas' cannot be verified.
catches: No official conversion rate: how many Nanas equal $1 is not published by MapizInc in any public source.
No official minimum redemption threshold published; the 30,000-nana figure circulates only in third-party content.
Reward is gift cards only (no cash), per the company's own listing; gift codes are emailed within 48 hours — email must be entered correctly.
Earning rates are low by third-party account ('extremely low earning potential' — takes very long to reach even $2).
iOS users download a differently-named app ('AppJoy Nana' / web flow via appnana.com) — brand fragmentation is a mild confusion risk.

c1.evidence: MapizInc — 'AppNana: Gift Cards Rewards' live on Google Play, v4.3.0 updated 04/08/25, 10M+ downloads, 413K reviews; official site appnana.com.

c2.evidence: FAILED — no concrete payout terms published by the company. Official Play listing states only: 'Complete tasks, earn points, and redeem for free gift cards... Get 400 daily points just by coming back every day... It will take up to 48 hours for us to send the gift code.' No conversion rate, no minimum.

c3.evidence: Free to join; no participation fee.

c4.evidence: Official company-authored Google Play listing obtained (package com.appnana.android.giftcardrewards); confirms the program mechanics but not a payout rate.

eligibility: Smartphone (Android app or iOS web/app flow); email + password signup; free.
notes: Real operating app, still maintained (2025 update) — but rejected under the strict rule: concrete payout terms published by the company itself. The catalog's 30,000-nana minimum is unsourced. Same standard as the Nielsen rejection: legit company, no concrete payout in official terms.

s1.note: Open signup; no stated country/age gates on the official listing.

s2.note: No fees; gift cards only (no cash); email accuracy required for reward delivery.

s3.note: Rewards emailed as gift codes within 48 hours of redemption — official.

s4.note: Official copy promises 'free gift cards' and 'Members have already earned over $10 million in gift card credits' — marketing aggregate, no per-user payout terms.

s5.note: https://appnana.com — official site; Play Store listing is the company-authored source.

s6.note: Download-and-earn steps exist, but no concrete redeem step can be written from official terms (no threshold/rate).

s7.note: Play listing data crawled within ~2 months of check; app last updated 04/08/25.

timing: Gift codes emailed within 48 hours of redemption (official).
